CRITICAL PREVIOUS ERROR TO AVOID: the camera is INSIDE the closed cockpit. Do NOT draw an exterior open canopy lid, raised second dome, extra green overhead arch, duplicate rim, open roof, second glass shell or spaceship exterior on top of this shot. Keep the SINGLE closed dome mostly out of frame: only a continuous smooth curved transparent window with a subtle reflection at upper-right and a narrow cream/green cockpit sill at bottom. Camera sits inside glass, so do not wrap an extra visible cutaway glass bubble around the dog. No exposed space opening. No added rings above the canopy.

Composition: fixed medium close-up from inside front-left cockpit, looking toward the approved adult green dog on the LEFT 60% of picture. The dog is naturally seated in the original cream padded seat. Entire face and BOTH head ball-tipped antennas visible, face/body ORIGINAL proportions, relaxed tiny original smile. Head looks forward toward SCREEN RIGHT, NOT at camera and NOT yet down at controls. Small portion of ORIGINAL controls visible lower-right: TWO separate slender green joystick stems with cream spherical knobs and the central LOW flat cream oval button on green plinth. NO huge additional radar dashboard, no new wall panels. A little deep-blue space and soft Earth glow through single closed window on right. Seat behind on left. Keep room upper-right blank for ? to be added later.
Identity strict: drooping green dog ears; large rounded triangular glossy black eyes with large white four-point star, small grey star and tiny pale diamond in original positions; cream muzzle tightly surrounds nose/mouth; original rounded inverted-triangle black nose; only two ball-tipped antennas; small near-round cream belly patch flat with body; smooth low-gloss green skin; short rounded arms with paws resting naturally near original controls. No clothes, no fur, no blush, no baby redesign, no human fingers or teeth, no added pads on hand backs. Maintain original head depth from reference2. Do not shrink face into baby toy style. Cute through restrained posture, not redesign.
Soft cool blue Earth bounce and warm cream-seat light, same light throughout. Simple stable scene for image-to-video, modest detail. Eyes open, small relaxed smile, no talking. No movement implied yet. No text, logo, speech bubble, arrows, labels or collage. Do not add a question mark. One single full-frame portrait image.
